message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films across various sub‑genres:

| # | Title | Year | Sub‑genre | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|-----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Psychological / Gothic | Kubrick’s masterful build‑up of dread and iconic imagery. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Supernatural / Family trauma | A chilling exploration of grief with a truly unsettling climax. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Social satire / Thriller | Clever social commentary wrapped in a tense horror narrative. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Survival / Sci‑fi | Silence as a survival tool creates constant tension. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Folk horror | Daylight terror that turns the usual “dark” setting on its head. |
| 6 | **It Follows** | 2014 | Urban legend / Psychological | A simple premise turned into an existential nightmare. |
| 7 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological / Mythic | A metaphorical monster that feels deeply personal. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | Paranormal / Found footage | A well‑crafted haunted house story with strong character arcs. |
| 9 | **Suspiria (1977)** | 1977 | Giallo / Art horror | Visually striking, haunting score, and a surreal atmosphere. |
|10 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Period / Folk horror | Slow‑burn dread set in Puritan New England. |
|11 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Found footage | Low‑budget ingenuity that made audiences jump at every creak. |
|12 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Japanese remake | A cursed videotape that became a pop‑culture staple. |
|13 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Meta‑horror | A twisty homage that deconstructs genre tropes. |
|14 | **The Others** | 2001 | Gothic / Mystery | A slow‑building mystery that delivers a memorable reveal. |
|15 | **Poltergeist** | 1982 | Classic supernatural | A family‑friendly scare that still feels creepy today. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want psychological depth, supernatural chills, or something that plays with expectations!
